svg.title: NajdiLab: local Chat to reviewed dataset and external Unsloth export
svg.desc: Separately managed inference and authorized local inputs enter request checks. Completed consented Chat pairs enter human review, privacy, quality, deduplication and holdout gates. Immutable dataset versions provide a file handoff. SQLite records and file manifests remain distinct; recovery is private and uses a separate location.
svg.text: NajdiLab · Chat → Review → Quality → Version → External export
Local dataset preparation · externally managed inference · no internal trainer
Separately managed local inference
LM Studio / Ollama · explicit connection and consent
Exact context admission · immutable model identity
Authorized local inputs
Credentialed completed-turn ingestion / manual data
Hermes BLOCKED · no native application history capture
Loopback request boundary
Host / Origin / Fetch Metadata · bounded JSON · CSRF for browser writes
Native ingestion: bearer OR raw-body HMAC · local trusted operator only
Own Chat and pending human review
Complete-turn receipts · revisions · Stop and rollover
Collection OFF by default / restart; complete pairs only
Correction and explicit eligibility; originals stay
Dataset quality and privacy
Whole-context privacy / exclusions · review integrity
Dedup · balance · holdout / leakage · masks
PASS does not establish truth, rights or consent
SQLite: records and provenance
Original messages · separate corrections and flags
Chat receipts / consent · manual / version metadata
Startup migration caveats remain; no schema cleanup
Immutable dataset versions
Filesystem JSONL + manifest / counts / SHA256
Verified privacy-attested source and holdout snapshot
New versions only; existing exports stay preserved
Private backup and separate restore
SQLite online snapshot + declared file inventory
Verify hashes / integrity / FKs / counts in a new location
Raw archives stay private; archive is not erasure
External Unsloth file handoff
Prompt/completion JSONL · provenance · manifest
Sole completion target; no packing or truncation
External operator owns training setup and rights
Arrows are data relationships, not network services. SQLite metadata and dataset files are distinct.
Limits: no RBAC / HMAC freshness; same-user file access; installed-model acceptance remains separate.
Source cleanup changes no private data or applied migration. Publication, retention and rights gates stay open.
